articles.heading: , the Organization, through its appropriate organs, and subject to the competence of each of the Unions
articles.text:
Aux fins d’atteindre le but défini à l’article 3,
l’Organisation, par ses organes compétents et
sous réserve de la compétence de chacune des
Unions :
(i) shall promote the development of measures
designed to facilitate the efficient protection of
intellectual property throughout the world and
to harmonize national legislation in this field;
i) s’emploie à promouvoir l’adoption de
mesures destinées à améliorer la protection de
la propriété intellectuelle à travers le monde et
à mettre en harmonie les législations nationales
dans ce domaine;
(ii) shall perform the administrative tasks of
the Paris Union, the Special Unions established
in relation with that Union, and the Berne
Union;
ii) assure les services administratifs de l’Union
de Paris, des Unions particulières établies en
relation avec cette Union et de l’Union de
Berne;
6
(iii) may agree to assume, or participate in, the
administration of any other international
agreement designed to promote the protection
of intellectual property;
iii) peut accepter d’assumer l’administration
qu’implique la mise en œuvre de tout autre
engagement international tendant à
promouvoir la protection de la propriété
intellectuelle ou de participer à une telle
administration;
(iv) shall encourage the conclusion of
international agreements designed to promote
the protection of intellectual property;
iv) encourage la conclusion de tout
engagement international tendant à
promouvoir la protection de la propriété
intellectuelle;
(v) shall offer its cooperation to States
requesting legal–technical assistance in the
field of intellectual property;
v) offre sa coopération aux Etats qui lui
demandent une assistance technico-juridique
dans le domaine de la propriété intellectuelle;
(vi) shall assemble and disseminate
information concerning the protection of
intellectual property, carry out and promote
studies in this field, and publish the results of
such studies;
vi) rassemble et diffuse toutes informations
relatives à la protection de la propriété
intellectuelle, effectue et encourage des études
dans ce domaine et en publie les résultats;
(vii) shall maintain services facilitating the
international protection of intellectual property
and, where appropriate, provide for
registration in this field and the publication of
the data concerning the registrations;
vii) assure les services facilitant la protection
internationale de la propriété intellectuelle et,
le cas échéant, procède à des enregistrements
en la matière et publie les indications relatives
à ces enregistrements;
(viii) shall take all other appropriate action. viii) prend toutes autres mesures appropriées.

général ou un membre du personnel désigné

Unions shall include provision for expenses of
interest to several Unions.

que le montant de la contribution de chaque

dépenses communes sont effectuées dans

de l’Organisation.

include provision for the expenses of holding

articles.heading: Capacité juridique; privilèges et immunités (1) The Organization shall enjoy on the territory of each Member State, in conformity
articles.text:
with the laws of that State, such legal capacity
as may be necessary for the fulfillment of the
Organization’s objectives and for the exercise
of its functions.
(1) L’Organisation jouit, sur le territoire de
chaque Etat membre, conformément aux lois
de cet Etat, de la capacité juridique nécessaire
pour atteindre son but et exercer ses fonctions.
(2) The Organization shall conclude a
headquarters agreement with the Swiss
Confederation and with any other State in
which the headquarters may subsequently be
located.
(2) L’Organisation conclut un accord de siège
avec la Confédération suisse et avec tout autre
Etat où le siège pourrait être fixé par la suite.
(3) The Organization may conclude bilateral or
multilateral agreements with the other Member
States with a view to the enjoyment by the
Organization, its officials, and representatives
of all Member States, of such privileges and
immunities as may be necessary for the
fulfillment of its objectives and for the exercise
of its functions.
(3) L’Organisation peut conclure des accords
bilatéraux ou multilatéraux avec les autres
Etats membres pour s’assurer, ainsi qu’à ses
fonctionnaires et aux représentants de tous les
Etats membres, la jouissance des privilèges et
immunités nécessaires pour atteindre son but et
exercer ses fonctions.
29

the Director General after approval by the
Coordination Committee.

Director General.
(1) Tout Etat membre peut dénoncer la
présente Convention par notification adressée
au Directeur général.
(2) Denunciation shall take effect six months
after the day on which the Director General has
received the notification.
(2) La dénonciation prend effet six mois après
la date à laquelle le Directeur général a reçu la
notification.

articles.heading: Notifications Article 19 : Notifications The Director General shall notify the Governments of all Member States of
articles.text:
Le Directeur général notifie aux
Gouvernements de tous les Etats membres :
(i) the date of entry into force of the
Convention,
(i) la date d’entrée en vigueur de la
Convention;
(ii) signatures and deposits of instruments of
ratification or accession,
(ii) les signatures et dépôts d’instruments de
ratification ou d’adhésion;
(iii) acceptances of an amendment to this
Convention, and the date upon which the
amendment enters into force,
(iii) les acceptations de modifications de la
présente Convention et la date à laquelle ces
modifications entrent en vigueur;
(iv) denunciations of this Convention. (iv) les dénonciations de la présente
Convention.

articles.heading: Final Provisions Article 20 : Dispositions protocolaires 35 (1) (a) This Convention shall be signed in a
articles.text:
single copy in English, French, Russian and
Spanish, all texts being equally authentic, and
shall be deposited with the Government of
Sweden.
(1) a) La présente Convention est signée en un
seul exemplaire en langues anglaise,
espagnole, française et russe, ces textes faisant
également foi ; elle est déposée auprès du
Gouvernement de la Suède.
(b) This Convention shall remain open for
signature at Stockholm until January 13, 1968.
(b) La présente Convention reste ouverte à la
signature à Stockholm jusqu’au 13 janvier
1968.
(2) Official texts shall be established by the
Director General, after consultation with the
interested Governments, in German, Italian
and Portuguese, and such other languages as
the Conference may designate.
(2) Des textes officiels sont établis par le
Directeur général, après consultation des
Gouvernements intéressés, dans les langues
allemande, italienne et portugaise et dans les
autres langues que la Conférence pourra
indiquer.
(3) The Director General shall transmit two
duly certified copies of this Convention and of
each amendment adopted by the Conference to
the Governments of the States members of the
Paris or Berne Unions, to the Government of
any other State when it accedes to this
Convention, and, on request, to the
Government of any other State. The copies of
the signed text of the Convention transmitted
to the Governments shall be certified by the
Government of Sweden.
(3) Le Directeur général transmet deux copies
certifiées conformes de la présente Convention
et de toute modification adoptée par la
Conférence aux Gouvernements des Etats
membres des Unions de Paris ou de Berne, au
Gouvernement de tout autre Etat lorsqu’il
adhère à la présente Convention et au
Gouvernement de tout autre Etat qui en fait la
demande. Les copies du texte signé de la
Convention qui sont transmises aux
Gouvernements sont certifiées conformes par
le Gouvernement de la Suède.
36
(4) The Director General shall register this
Convention with the Secretariat of the United
Nations.
(4) Le Directeur général fait enregistrer la
présente Convention auprès du Secrétariat de
l’Organisation des Nations Unies.

articles.heading: Transitional Provisions Article 21 : Clauses transitoires (1) Until the first Director General assumes
articles.text:
office, references in this Convention to the
International Bureau or to the Director General
shall be deemed to be references to the United
International Bureau for the Protection of
Industrial, Literary and Artistic Property (also
called the United International Bureau for the
Protection of Intellectual Property (BIRPI)), or
its Director, respectively.
(1) Jusqu’à l’entrée en fonction du premier
Directeur général, les références, dans la
présente Convention, au Bureau international
ou au Directeur général sont considérées
comme se rapportant respectivement aux
Bureaux internationaux réunis pour la
protection de la propriété industrielle, littéraire
et artistique (également dénommés Bureaux
internationaux réunis pour la protection de la
propriété intellectuelle (BIRPI)), ou à leur
Directeur.
(2) (a) States which are members of any of the
Unions but which have not become party to
this Convention may, for five years from the
date of entry into force of this Convention,
exercise, if they so desire, the same rights as if
they had become party to this Convention. Any
State desiring to exercise such rights shall give
written notification to this effect to the Director
General; this notification shall be effective on
the date of its receipt. Such States shall be
deemed to be members of the General
Assembly and the Conference until the
expiration of the said period.
(2) (a) Les Etats qui sont membres de l’une des
Unions, mais qui ne sont pas encore devenus
parties à la présente Convention, peuvent,
pendant cinq ans à compter de la date de son
entrée en vigueur, exercer, s’ils le désirent, les
mêmes droits que s’ils y étaient parties. Tout
Etat qui désire exercer lesdits droits dépose à
cette fin auprès du Directeur général une
notification écrite qui prend effet à la date de
sa réception. De tels Etats sont réputés être
membres de l’Assemblée générale et de la
Conférence jusqu’à l’expiration de ladite
période.
37
(b) Upon expiration of this five–year period,
such States shall have no right to vote in the
General Assembly, the Conference, and the
Coordination Committee.
(b) A l’expiration de la période de cinq ans, ces
Etats n’ont plus le droit de vote à l’Assemblée
générale, à la Conférence ou au Comité de
coordination.
(c) Upon becoming party to this Convention,
such States shall regain such right to vote.
(c) Dès qu’ils sont devenus parties à la présente
Convention, lesdits Etats peuvent exercer à
nouveau le droit de vote.
(3) (a) As long as there are States members of
the Paris or Berne Unions which have not
become party to this Convention, the
International Bureau and the Director General
shall also function as the United International
Bureau for the Protection of Industrial,
Literary and Artistic Property, and its Director,
respectively.
3) (a) Aussi longtemps que tous les Etats
membres des Unions de Paris ou de Berne ne
sont pas devenus parties à la présente
Convention, le Bureau international et le
Directeur général exercent également les
fonctions dévolues respectivement aux
Bureaux internationaux réunis pour la
protection de la propriété industrielle, littéraire
et artistique, et à leur Directeur.
(b) The staff in the employment of the said
Bureau on the date of entry into force of this
Convention shall, during the transitional
period referred to in subparagraph (a), be
considered as also employed by the
International Bureau.
(b) Le personnel en fonction aux Bureaux
susvisés à la date d’entrée en vigueur de la
présente Convention est, durant la période
transitoire visée au sous-alinéa a), considéré
comme également en fonction au Bureau
international.
(4) (a) Once all the States members of the Paris
Union have become Members of the
Organization, the rights, obligations, and
property, of the Bureau of that Union shall
devolve on the International Bureau of the
Organization.
(4) (a) Lorsque tous les Etats membres de
l’Union de Paris sont devenus membres de
l’Organisation, les droits, obligations et biens
du Bureau de cette Union sont dévolus au
Bureau international de l’Organisation.
38
(b) Once all the States members of the Berne
Union have become Members of the
Organization, the rights, obligations, and
property, of the Bureau of that Union shall
devolve on the International Bureau of the
Organization.
(b) Lorsque tous les Etats membres de l’Union
de Berne sont devenus membres de
l’Organisation, les droits, obligations et biens
du Bureau de cette Union sont dévolus au
Bureau international de l’Organisation.

articles.heading: Ishyirwaho ry'umuryango Hashyizweho Umuryango Mpuzamahanga w'Umutungo bwite mu by'ubwenge
Ibisobanuro Muri aya Masezerano
articles.text:
umutungo bwite mu by'ubwenge ayoborwa
n'umuryango hakurikijwe ingingo ya 4(iii);
(viii) “Umutungo bwite mu by'ubwenge”
ukubiyemo uburenganzira burebana n'ibi
bikurikira:
– ibihangano by`ubuvanganzo, iby`ubugeni
n'ubumenyi,
– imikino n`indirimbo by`ibihangano
bikorwa n`abanyabugeni, fonogaramu, ndetse
n`isakaza rya radiyo,
– ubuvumbuzi mu nzego zose bukorwa
n`abantu,
– ubuvumbuzi mu by'ubumenyi,
– Ibishushanyo bikorerwa mu nganda,
– ibirango by'inganda iby`ubucuruzi, n`ibya
serivisi, amazina n'inyito by'ubucuruzi,
– gukumira ipiganwa ririmo uburiganya,
n'ubundi burenganzira bwose bufitanye isano
n`ibikorwa by'ubwenge mu nzego z'inganda,
ubumenyi, ubuvanganzo n'ubugeni.

articles.heading: Intego z'Umuryango Intego z'Umuryango ni izi zikurikira
articles.text:
(i) guteza imbere uburyo bwo kurengera
umutungo bwite mu by'ubwenge ku isi hose
binyuze mu bufatanye hagati y'ibihugu, aho
bibaye ngombwa ku bufatanye n'indi
miryango mpuzamahanga,
(ii) biharanira ko habaho ubufatanye mu
rwego rw'imiyoborere hagati y'amahuriro.

articles.heading: Imikorere y'Umuryango Mu rwego rwo kugera ku ntego zagaragajwe mu ngingo ya 3, Umuryango, binyuze mu
articles.text:
nzego zawo zibishinzwe, kandi haseguriwe
ubushobozi bwa buri Huriro:
(i) uteza imbere ishyirwaho ry'ingamba
zigamije koroshya uburyo bunoze bwo
kurengera umutungo bwite mu by'ubwenge
ku isi hose no guhuza amategeko y`igihugu
muri uru rwego;
(ii) ukora imirimo ijyanye n'ubuyobozi
bw'Ihuriro rya Paris, Amahuriro yihariye
yashyizweho mu buryo bujyanye n'iryo
Huriro, n'Ihuriro rya Berne;
(iii) ushobora kwemera gufata inshingano
cyangwa se kugira uruhare mu micungire
y'andi masezerano mpuzamahanga yegenewe
guteza imbere uburyo bwo kurengera
umutungo bwite mu by'ubwenge;
(iv) ushishikariza gushyira umukono ku
masezerano mpuzamahanga agamije guteza
imbere uburyo bwo kurengera umutungo
bwite mu by'ubwenge;
(v) ushyiraho umurongo w'ubufatanye
n'ibindi bihugu bisaba ubufasha bwa tekiniki
mu by'amategeko mu bijyanye n'umutungo
bwite mu by'ubwenge;
(vi) ukusanya ndetse ugasakaza amakuru
arebana no kurengera umutungo bwite mu
by'ubwenge, gukora no guteza imbere
ubushakashatsi muri uru rwego, no gutangaza
ibyavuye muri ubwo bushakashatsi;
(vii) ugumishaho serivisi zo gufasha
kurengera ku rwego mpuzamahanga
umutungo bwite mu by'ubwenge, no gutanga,
aho biri ngombwa uburyo bwo kuwandikisha
no gutangaza amakuru arebana n'imitungo
bwite mu bwenge yandikishijwe;
(viii) ukora ibindi bikorwa byose bikwiye
muri uru rwego.

articles.heading: Kuba umunyamuryango (1) Kuba umunyamuryango mu Muryango byemererwa igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose kiri
articles.text:
muri rimwe mu mahuriro hubahirijwe
ibikubiye mu ngingo ya 2(vii).
(2) Kuba umunyamuryango w'Umuryango
kandi byemerewe igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose
kitari muri rimwe mu mahuriro yavuzwe
haruguru ariko hubahirijwe ibi bikurikira:
(i) Kuba icyo gihugu kigize Umuryango
w'Abibumbye, rimwe mu mashami yihariye
ashamikiye ku Muryango w'Abibumbye,
cyangwa Ikigo Mpuzamahanga ku ikoreshwa
ry`Ingufu za Kirimbuzi, cyangwa se kiri mu
bihugu byemeje amategeko agenga Urukiko
mpuzamahanga, cyangwa
(ii) cyatumiwe mu Nteko Rusange kugira ngo
kibe kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano.

articles.heading: Inteko Rusange (1) (a) Hashyizweho Inteko Rusange igizwe n'ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
articles.text:
bigize rimwe mu mahuriro yavuzwe
haruguru.
(b) Guverinoma ya buri gihugu ihagarariwe
n'umuntu umwe ushobora kungirizwa
n'abandi bantu, abajyanama ndetse
n'inzobere.
(c) Amafaranga ya buri tsinda rihagarariye
igihugu yishyurwa na Guverinoma
yashyizeho iryo tsinda.
(2) Inteko Rusange ishinzwe:
(i) gushyiraho Umuyobozi Mukuru amaze
gutoranywa na Komite Mpuzabikorwa;
(ii) gusuzuma no kwemeza raporo
y'Umuyobozi Mukuru irebana n'Umuryango
no kumuha amabwiriza ya ngombwa;
(iii) gusuzuma no kwemeza raporo n'ibikorwa
bya Komite Mpuzabikorwa no kuyiha
amabwiriza ya ngombwa;
(iv) kwemeza ingengo y'imari ya buri myaka
ibiri y'ibikorwa rusange by'amahuriro;
(v) kwemeza ingamba zatanzwe
n'Umuyobozi Mukuru n'imicungire
y'Amasezerano mpuzamahanga ziteganywa
mu ngingo ya 4(iii);
(vi) kwemeza amabwiriza y'Umuryango
agenga imari;
(vii) kugena indimi zemewe mu
Bunyamabanga, hitabwa ku mikoreshereze
yazo mu Muryango w'Abibumbye;
(viii) gutumira ibihugu biteganywa mu
ngingo ya 5(2)(ii) kugira ngo byinjizwe muri
aya Masezerano;
(ix) kugena ibihugu bitari mu Muryango
n'imiryango ya Leta ndetse n'imiryango
mpuzamahanga itari iya Leta byitabira inama
nk'indorerezi;
(x) Gukora indi mirimo ibona ko ikwiye muri
aya Masezerano.
(3) (a) Buri gihugu, cyaba ikiri mu muryango
w'ihuriro rimwe cyangwa menshi kigira ijwi
rimwe mu matora y'Inteko rusange.
(b) Kimwe cya kabiri cy'ibihugu bigize Inteko
Rusange gifatwa nk`umubare wa ngombwa.
(c) Hatitawe ku biteganywa mu gaka (b), iyo,
mu nteko iyo ari yo yose, umubare w’Ibihugu
bihagarariwe utageze kuri kimwe cya kabiri
ariko ungana cyangwa urenga kimwe cya
gatatu cy’ibihugu bigize Inteko Rusange,
Inteko Rusange ishobora gufata ibyemezo
uretse gusa ibyemezo bijyanye n'uburyo
bw'imikorere yayo, ibyo byemezo byose
bitangira gukurikizwa ari uko ibisabwa
bikurikira byujujwe. Ibiro Mpuzamahanga
bimenyesha ibihugu bigize Umuryango bitari
bihagarariwe ibyo byemezo by'Inteko
rusange kandi bikabisaba kwerekana mu
nyandiko amajwi yabyo cyangwa kwifata mu
gihe kitarenze amezi atatu uhereye ku itariki
bibimenyesherejweho. Iyo icyo gihe
kirangiye, umubare w'ibihugu byatanze
amajwi yabyo cyangwa byifashe wageze ku
mubare w'ibihugu byaburaga kugira ngo
umubare wa ngombwa muri iyo nteko
ugerweho, ibyo byemezo bitangira
gukurikizwa igihe cyose ubwiganze busabwa
bwagezweho.
(d) Haseguriwe ibiteganywa mu duka (e) na
(f), Inteko Rusange ifata ibyemezo ku
bwiganze bwa bibiri bya gatatu by'amajwi
yatanzwe.
(e) Kwemeza ingamba zijyanye n`imicungire
y’amasezerano mpuzamahanga ziteganywa
mu ngingo ya 4 (iii) bisaba ubwiganze bwa
bitatu bya kane by’amajwi yatanzwe.
(f) Kwemeza amasezerano agiranwa
n’Umuryango w’Abibumbye hashingiwe ku
ngingo ya 57 n’iya 63 z’Amasezerano
y’Umuryango w’Abibumbye bisaba
ubwiganze bw’amajwi icyenda ku icumi
y’amajwi yatanzwe.
(g) Ku birebana no gushyiraho Umuyobozi
Mukuru (igika (2)(i)), kwemeza ingamba
zatanzwe n'Umuyobozi Mukuru zirebana
n'imicungire y'amasezerano mpuzamahanga
(igika (2)(v)), no guhindura icyicaro gikuru
(ingingo ya 10), ubwiganze busabwa
bugomba kugerwaho bitari gusa mu Nteko
Rusange ahubwo no mu Nteko y'Ihuriro rya
Paris n'Ihuriro rya Berne.
(h) Kwifata ntibishobora gufatwa nk'itora.
(i) Uhagarariye igihugu cye atora mw`izina
ryacyo kandi ahagarira igihugu kimwe gusa .
(4) (a) Inteko Rusange iterana incuro imwe
buri myaka ibiri mu ntekoteko isanzwe
igatumirwa n'Umuyobozi Mukuru.
(b) Inteko Rusange iterana mu nteko
idasanzwe itumijwe n'Umuyobozi Mukuru
cyangwa bisabwe na Komite mpuzabikorwa
cyangwa se bisabwe na kimwe cya kane
cy'ibihugu bigize Inteko Rusange.
(c) Inama ziteranira ku cyicaro
cy'Umuryango.
(5) Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bitari ibigize Umuryango wa rimwe mu
mahuriro yavuzwe haruguru byemererwa
kwitabira inama z'Inteko Rusange
nk'indorerezi.
(6) Inteko Rusange yemeza amategeko
ngengamikorere yayo.

articles.heading: Inama (1) (a) Hashyizweho Inama igizwe n'ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano byaba biri cyangwa se bitari muri rimwe mu mahuriro
articles.text:
yavuzwe haruguru.
(b) Guverinoma ya buri gihugu ihagararirwa
n'umuntu umwe ushobora kungirizwa
n'abandi bantu, abajyanama ndetse
n'inzobere.
(c) Amafaranga akoreshwa na buri tsinda
rihagarariye igihugu yishyurwa na
Guverinoma yashyizeho iryo tsinda.
(2) Inama ishinzwe:
(i) kuganira ku bibazo birebana n'inyungu
rusange mu bijyanye no kurengera umutungo
bwite mu by'ubwenge no gufata
ibyifuzonama bijyanye n'ibyo bibazo,
hakurikijwe ubushobozi n'ubwigenge
by'Amahuriro;
(ii) kwemeza ingengo y'imari ya buri myaka
ibiri y'Inama;
(iii) gushyiraho gahunda ya buri myaka ibiri
y'ubufasha bwa tekiniki mu by'amategeko mu
bigakorwa hagendewe ku ngengo y'imari
yagenwe y'inama;
(iv) kwemeza amavuguruwa y`aya
Masezerano nk'uko biteganywa mu ngingo ya
17;
(v) kugena ibihugu bitari ibigize Umuryango
n'imiryango ya Leta ndetse n'imiryango
mpuzamahanga itari iya Leta igomba
kwitabira inama z'inteko rusange
nk'indorerezi;
(vi) Gukora indi mirimo ibona ko ikwiye muri
aya Masezerano.
(3) (a) Buri gihugu kigize Umuryango kigira
ijwi rimwe mu matora y'Inama.
(b) Umubare wa ngombwa kugira ngo inama
iterane ni kimwe cya gatatu cy'ibihugu bigize
Umuryango.
(c) Haseguriwe ibiteganywa mu ngingo ya 17,
Inama ifata ibyemezo ku bwiganze bwa bibiri
bya gatatu by'amajwi yatanzwe.
(d) Ingano y'imisanzu y'ibihugu bihuriye kuri
aya Masezerano bitari muri rimwe mu
mahuriro igenwa binyuze mu matora akorwa
gusa n'abahagariye ibyo bihugu kandi bafite
uburenganzira bwo gutora.
(e) Kwifata ntibishobora gufatwa nk'itora.
(f) Uhagarariye igihugu cye atora mw`izina
ryacyo kandi ahagarira igihugu kimwe gusa.
(4) (a) Inama iterana mu nteko isanzwe
itumijwe n'Umuyobozi Mukuru, muri icyo
gihe kandi iteranira ahasanzwe hateranira
Inteko Rusange.
(b) Inama iterana mu nteko zidasanzwe
itumijwe n'Umuyobozi Mukuru bisabwe ku
bwiganze bw'ibihugu bigize Umuryango.
(5) Inama yemeza amategeko
ngengamikorere yayo.

articles.heading: Komite Mpuzabikorwa (1) (a) Hashyizweho Komite Mpuzabikorwa igizwe n'ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
articles.text:
Masezerano bigize Komite Nyobozi y'Ihuriro
rya Paris, cyangwa Komite Nyobozi y'Ihuriro
rya Berne, cyangwa ayo mahuriro yombi.
Icyakora, iyo imwe muri za Komite Nyobozi
igizwe n'ibihugu birenze kimwe cya kane mu
bihugu bigize inteko rusange byayitoye, iyo
Komite Nyobozi igena bimwe mu bihugu
biyigize bishyirwa muri Komite
Mpuzabikorwa, ibyo bigakorwa mu buryo
umubare wabyo utarenga kimwe cya kane
cyavuzwe haruguru, byumvikane neza ko
igihugu giherereyemo icyicaro
cy'Umuryango kitabarwa muri uwo mubare
wavuzwe wa kimwe cya kane.
(b) Guverinoma ya buri gihugu kigize Komite
mpuzabikorwa ihagararirwa n'umuntu umwe
ushobora kungirizwa n'abandi bantu,
abajyanama ndetse n'inzobere.
(c) Igihe cyose Komite Mpuzabikorwa
isuzumye ibibazo bifitanye isano itaziguye na
gahunda cyangwa ingengo y’imari y’inama
na gahunda yayo, cyangwa ibyifuzo byo
kuvugurura aya Masezerano byagira ingaruka
ku burenganzira cyangwa inshingano
z’ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bitari
mu ihuriro na rimwe, kimwe cya kane
cy’ibihugu ni cyo cyitabira inama za Komite
Mpuzabikorwa kandi ibyo bihugu bikagira
uburenganzira bumwe n'ubw'abandi bagize
Komite. Inama igena ibyo bihugu mu nteko
zayo zose zisanzwe.
() Amafaranga ya buri tsinda rihagarariye
igihugu yishyurwa na Guverinoma
yashyizeho iryo tsinda.
(2) Iyo ayandi mahuriro ayobowe
n'Umuryango yifuje guhagararirwa muri
ubwo buryo muri Komite Mpuzabikorwa,
abayahagarariye bashyirwaho baturutse mu
bihugu bigize Komite Mpuzabikorwa.
(3) Komite Mpuzabikorwa ishinzwe:
(i) Kugira inama Inzego z'amahuriro, Inteko
Rusange, Inama, n'Umuyobozi Mukuru ku
bibazo byose birebana n'imiyoborere n'imari
bifitiye inyungu rusange amahuriro abiri
cyangwa menshi, cyangwa ihuriro rimwe
cyangwa menshi hamwe n`Umuryango,
by'umwihariko ku birebana n'ingengo y'imari
ihuriweho n'amahuriro;
(ii) gutegura umushinga w'ibyigirwa mu
nama y'Inteko Rusange;
(iii) gutegura umushinga w'ingengabihe
n'umushinga wa gahunda n`ingengo y`imari
y`Inama;
(iv) [yarasibwe]
(v) igihe manda y'Umuyobozi Mukuru igiye
kurangira, cyangwa iyo hari umwanya
w'akazi uri ku mwanya w'Umuyobozi
Mukuru, Komite ishyiraho umukandida
uzashyirwa kuri uwo mwanya n'Inteko
Rusange; iyo Inteko Rusange idashyizeho
uwatoranyijwe, Komite Mpuzabikorwa
ishyiraho undi mukandida; ubu buryo
busubirwamo kugeza igihe uwatoranyijwe
bwa nyuma ashyizweho n'Inteko Rusange;
(vi) iyo umwanya w'Umuyobozi Mukuru
ubuze uwujyamo hagati y'inama ebyiri
z'Inteko Rusange, Komite ishyiraho
Umuyobozi Mukuru w'agateganyo muri
manda ibanziriza igihe Umuyobozi Mukuru
mushya ushyirwaho atangirira imirimo;
(vii) gukora indi mirimo yose isabwa
iteganywa n`aya Masezerano.
(4) (a) Komite Mpuzabikorwa iterana rimwe
mu mwaka mu nama isanzwe, itumijwe
n'Umuyobozi Mukuru. Komite
mpuzabikorwa iteranira ku cyicaro
cy'Umuryango.
(b) Komite Mpuzabikorwa iterana mu nteko
idasanzwe itumijwe n'Umuyobozi Mukuru,
ku bushake bwe cyangwa se abisabwe
n'Umuyobozi wa Komite cyangwa na kimwe
cya gatatu cy'abayigize.
(5) (a) Buri gihugu cyaba kiri mu bigize imwe
muri Komite Nyobozi ziteganywa mu gika
cya (1) (a), gifite ijwi rimwe mu matora ya
Komite Mpuzabikorwa.
(b) Kimwe cya kabiri cy'abigize Komite
Mpuzabikorwa ni cyo kigize umubare usabwa
ngo inama iterane.
(c) Uhagarariye igihugu atora mw`izina
ryacyo kandi ahagarira igihugu kimwe gusa.
(6) (a) Komite Mpuzabikorwa itanga
ibitekerezo byayo ifata ibyemezo byayo ku
bwiganze bw'amajwi yatanzwe. Kwifata
ntibishobora gufatwa nk'itora.
(b) N'iyo ubwiganze busanzwe bwaba
bwabonetse, umunyamuryango wa Komite
Mpuzabikorwa ashobora ako kanya nyuma
y'amatora gusaba ko kubara amajwi
bisubirwamo mu buryo bwihariye bigakorwa
mu buryo bukurikira: hategurwa intonde
ebyiri zitandukanye, urutonde rumwe ruriho
amazina y'ibihugu bigize Komite Nyobozi
y'Ihuriro rya Paris naho urundi ruriho
amazina y'Ibihugu bigize Ihuriro rya Berne;
ijwi rya buri gihugu rigomba kwandikwa
imbere y'izina ryacyo kuri buri rutonde icyo
gihugu kigaragaraho. Iyo uku kongera kubara
amajwi bigaragaje ko ubwiganze butabonetse
mu majwi yabaruwe kuri izo ntonde zombi,
icyifuzo cyatanzwe gifatwa nk'ikitahawe
agaciro.
(7) Igihugu cyose kigize Umuryango kitari
kitagize Komite Mpuzabikorwa gishobora
guhagararirwa mu nama za Komite
n'indorerezi zifite uburenganzira bwo kugira
uruhare mu biganiro ariko zidafite
uburenganzira bwo gutora.
(8) Komite Mpuzabikorwa ishyiraho
amategeko ngengamikorere yayo.

articles.heading: Ibiro Mpuzamahanga (1) Ibiro Mpuzamahanga ni Ubunyamabanga bw'Umuryango
articles.text:
(2) Ibiro Mpuzamahanga biyoborwa
n'Umuyobozi Mukuru, wungirijwe
n'abayobozi bakuru babiri cyangwa se benshi.
(3) Umuyobozi Mukuru ashyirwaho
agahabwa manda igenwe itari munsi y'imyaka
itandatu. Yemerewe kongera gushyirwaho
mu zindi manda zigenwe. Ibihe bya mbere
by'ishyirwaho rye n'ibishobora gukurikira
ishyirwaho rye, ndetse n'ibindi bisabwa mu
gushyiraho abayobozi bigenwa n'Inteko
Rusange.
(4) (a) Umuyobozi Mukuru ni we uyobora
Umuryango.
(b) Ni we uhagararira Umuryango.
(c) Atanga raporo kandi agakurikiza
amabwiriza ahabwa n`Inteko Rusange ku
birebana n'ibikorwa by'imbere mu Muryango
ndetse no hanze yawo.
(5) Umuyobozi Mukuru ategura umushinga
wa za gahunda n'ingengo y'imari ndetse na
raporo zihoraho z'ibikorwa. Azoherereza za
Guverinoma z'ibihugu zibyifuza no ku nzego
zibifitiye ubasha mu mahuriro no mu
Muryango.
(6) Umuyobozi Mukuru ndetse n'abandi
bakozi bashyizweho na we bitabira inama
zose z'Inteko Rusange, iz'Inama, iza Komite
Mpuzabikorwa ndetse n'izindi nama cyangwa
amatsinda y'abakozi ariko ntibagira
uburenganzira bwo gutora. Umuyobozi
Mukuru cyangwa undi mukozi washyizweho
na we ahita agirwa umunyamabanga w'izo
nzego.
(7) Umuyobozi Mukuru ashyiraho abakozi
bose ba ngombwa bakenewe kugira ngo akazi
k'Ibiro mpuzamahanga kagende neza.
Ashyiraho abayobozi bakuru bungirije
bamaze kwemezwa na Komite
Mpuzabikorwa. Ibisabwa mu kazi bigenwa
n'amabwiriza agenga abakozi yemezwa na
Komite Mpuzabikorwa nyuma yo gutangwa
n'Umuyobozi Mukuru. Ni ingenzi kwita
cyane ku kazi k'abakozi no mu kugena
imiterere n'ibisabwa mu kazi bakora bigomba
kwitabwaho mu kugena urwego runoze rwo
hejuru mu mikorere ihamye, ubushobozi
n'ubunyangamugayo mu kazi. Ni ngombwa
kuzirikana akamaro ko gushaka abakozi mu
buryo bwagutse bushoboka kandi hagendewe
ku bihugu bakomokamo.
(8) Imiterere y'inshingano z'Umuyobozi
Mukuru ndetse n'abandi bakozi igomba kuba
iri ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Mu kuzuza
inshingano zabo ntibagomba gushaka
cyangwa se guhabwa amabwiriza na
Guverinoma iyo ari yo yose cyangwa undi
muyobozi utari mu Muryango. Birinda
igikorwa icyo ari cyo cyose gishobora
kubangamira akazi kabo nk'abayobozi
mpuzamahanga. Buri gihugu kigize
Umuryango cyiyemeza kubahiriza imiterere
mpuzamahanga y'inshingano z'Umuyobozi
Mukuru n'abakozi, kandi ntikigomba kubaha
umurongo ngenderwaho mu kazi kabo
cyangwa kuzuza inshingano zabo.

articles.heading: Icyicaro cy’Umuryango (1) icyicaro cy'Umuryango kiba i Jeneve mu Busuwisi
articles.text:
(2) Iyimurwa ryacyo rishobora kwemezwa
nk'uko biteganywa mu ngingo ya 6(3) (d) na
(g).

articles.heading: Imari (1) Umuryango ugira ingengo z'imari ebyiri zitandukanye: ingengo y'imari igenewe ibikorwa rusange by'amahuriro n'ingengo
articles.text:
y'imari igenewe Inama.
(2) (a) Ingengo y'Imari igenewe ibikorwa
bihuriweho n'Amahuriro igomba kuba
ikubiyemo amafaranga y'ibikorwa bifite
inyungu ku mahuriro atandukanye.
(b) Amafaranga y`ingengo y'imari aturuka
aha hakurikira:
(i) imisanzu itangwa n'amahuriro, igihe cyose
ingano y'iyo misanzu ya buri huriro igenwa
n'Inteko Rusange y'iryo huriro, hitawe ku
nyungu ihuriro rifite mu bikorwa rusange;
(ii) amafaranga yishyurwa serivisi zitangwa
n'Ibiro Mpuzamahanga zidafite aho zihuriye
mu buryo butaziguye n'izitangwa n'amahuriro
cyangwa atakiriwe biturutse kuri serivisi
zatanzwe n'Ibiro Mpuzamahanga mu rwego
rw'ubufasha bwa tekiniki mu by'amategeko;
(iii) kugurisha cyangwa amafaranga akomoka
ku mutungo bwite mu by'ubwenge ku
nyandiko cyangwa se ibitabo by'Ibiro
Mpuzamahanga adafite aho ahuriye mu buryo
butazigiye n'amahuriro;
(iv) impano, indagano n'inkunga zihabwa
Umuryango, usibye iziteganywa mu gika cya
(3)(b)(iv);
(v) ubukode, inyungu n'undi musaruro
utandukanye w'Umuryango.
(3) (a) Ingengo y'imari y'Inama ikubiyemo
amafaranga agenewe gahunda zo kwakira no
gutumiza inama ndetse na gahunda yo
gutanga ubufasha bwa tekiniki mu
by'amategeko.
(b) Amafaranga y`iyi ngengo y'imari aturuka
aha hakurikira:
(i) imisanzu itangwa n'Ibihugu bihuriye kuri
aya Masezerano bidafite ihuriro na rimwe
bibarizwamo;
(ii) amafaranga ayo ari yo yose yatanzwe kuri
iyi ngengo y'imari n'amahuriro, igihe cyose
ingano y'ayo mafaranga yatanzwe na buri
huriro ahyirwaho n'Inteko Rusange y'iryo
huriro ndetse na buri huriro rikaba rifite
uburenganzira busesuye bwo kwifata ku
gutanga umusanzu kuri iyi ngengo y'imari;
(iii) amafaranga yatanzwe kuri serivisi
zitangwa n'Ibiro Mpuzamahanga mu rwego
rw'ubufasha bwa tekiniki mu by'amategeko;
(iv) impano, indagano n'inkunga zihabwa
Umuryango hashingiwe ku biteganywa mu
gaka ka (a);
(4) (a) Mu rwego rwo gushyiraho umusanzu
ku ngengo y'imari y'Inama, buri gihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano kidafite ihuriro na
rimwe kibarizwamo kigomba kuba gifite
icyiciro kibarizwamo kandi cyishyura
imisanzu yacyo ya buri mwaka hashingiwe ku
mubare w'ibyiciro byashyizweho mu buryo
bukurikira:
Icyiciro A.......... 10
Icyiciro B.......... 3
Icyiciro C.......... 1
(b) Buri gihugu kigomba kugaragaza icyiciro
cyifuza gushyirwamo ibyo bikagendana no
gufata ingamba ziteganywa mu ngingo ya
14(1). Igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose gishobora
guhindura icyiciro kibarizwamo. Iyo igihugu
gihisemo icyiciro cyo hasi, kibitangariza
Inama muri imwe mu nteko zayo zisanzwe.
Izo mpinduka zitangira gukurikizwa mu
ntangiriro ya buri mwaka ukurikira igihe
inteko iheruka yabereye.
(c) Umusanzu ngarukamwaka wa buri gihugu
ugomba kuba uhwanye n’amafaranga yose
agomba gutangwa mu ngengo y’imari
y’Inama n’Ibihugu byose nk'uko umubare
w'ibyiciro biyigize ungana n’ibyiciro by’ibyo
bihugu byose byavuzwe.
(d) Imisanzu igomba gutangwa ku ya mbere
Mutarama wa buri mwaka.
(e) Iyo ingengo y'imari itemejwe mbere yo
gutangira umwaka mushya w'ingengo
y'imari, ingengo y'imari igomba kuba ingana
n'iy'umwaka wabanje hakurikijwe
amabwiriza agenga imari.
(5) Ibihugu byose bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano bidafite Ihuriro na rimwe
bibarizwamo bifite ibirarane mu kwishyura
imisanzu yabyo ku ngengo y'imari nk'uko
biteganywa n'iyi ngingo, n'ibihugu byose
biyahuriyeho bibarizwa mu Mahuriro kandi
bifite ibirarane by'imisanzu bitishyuye mu
Mahuriro bibarizwamo, ntibishobora gutora
mu nzego zose z'Umuryango bibarizwamo,
iyo ingano y'ibirarane by'imisanzu ingana
cyangwa se irenze ingano y'imisanzu
bigomba kwishyura mu myaka ibiri yabanje.
Icyakora, izi nzego zose zishobora kwemerera
bene ibyo bihugu gutora muri izo nzego igihe
cyose zemera ko ubukererwe mu kwishyura
imisanzu bwatewe n'impamvu zihariye kandi
ntakumirwa.
(6) Ingano y'amafaranga agomba kwishyurwa
kuri serivisi zitangwa n'Ibiro Mpuzamahanga
mu rwego rwo gutanga ubufasha bwa tekiniki
mu by'amategeko igomba gushyirwaho kandi
ikamenyeshwa Komite Mpuzabikorwa
n'Umuyobozi Mukuru.
(7) Umuryango, ubyemerewe na Komite
Mpuzabikorwa, ushobora kwakira impano,
indagano n'inkunga biturutse, mu buryo
butaziguye muri za Guverinoma, ibigo bya
Leta cyangwa ibyigenga, amashyirahamwe
cyangwa abantu ku giti cyabo.
(8) (a) Umuryango ufite ikigega cy'imari
shingiro yo kwifashisha mu bikorwa byawo
iboneka biturutse ku mafaranga atangwa
incuro imwe n'Amahuriro na buri gihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano kidafite ihuriro na
rimwe kibarizwamo. Iyo icyo kigega
kidahagije kirongerwa.
(b) Ingano amafaranga yishyurwa incuro
imwe na buri Huriro no kugira uruhare mu
iyongerwa iryo ari ryo ryose bigenwa n'Inteko
yayo.
(10) Kugenzura konti bikorwa n'igihugu
kimwe cyangwa byinshi bigize Umuryango,
cyangwa se n'abagenzuzi bigenga nk'uko
biteganywa n'amabwiriza agenga imari.
Abagenzuzi bashyirwaho n'Inteko Rusange
ndetse n'amasezerano yabo akemezwa na yo.

articles.heading: Ububasha mu by'amategeko; Uburenganzira bwihariye n'ubudahangarwa (1) Umuryango ugira uburenganzira ku
articles.text:
butaka bwa buri gihugu kigize Umuryango,
hakurikijwe amategeko y'icyo gihugu,
ububasha bw`amategeko iyo ari ngombwa mu
rwego rwo gukora imirimo yawo no kugera
ku ntego zawo.
(2) Umuryango ugirana amasezerano
yerekeranye n'icyicaro n'igihugu
cy'Ubusuwisi ndetse n'ibindi bihugu byose
bishobora gushyirwamo icyicaro cyawo.
(3) Umuryango ushobora kugirana
amasezerano n'igihugu kimwe cyangwa
byinshi mu bigize Umuryango hagamijwe ko
Umuryango, abayobozi bawo ndetse
n'abahagarariye ibihugu bigize Umuryango
bahabwa ubwo burenganzira bwihariye
n'ubudahangarwa bwa ngombwa mu kugera
ku ntego z'Umuryango no kuzuza neza
inshingano zawo.
(4) Umuyobozi Mukuru ashobora kugirana
imishyikirano n'ibihugu, ndetse byemejwe na
Komite Mpuzabikorwa, agashyira umukono
ku masezerano ateganyijwe mu bika bya (2)
na (3) mu izina ry'Umuryango.

articles.heading: Imibanire n'indi Miryango (1) Umuryango ushobora, aho biri ngombwa hose, gushyiraho imibanire n'imikoranire
articles.text:
n'indi miryango ya Leta. Amasezerano
Rusange yose yagiranye n'iyo miryango muri
ubwo buryo akorwa n'Umuyobozi Mukuru
amaze kwemezwa na Komite Mpuzabikorwa.
(2) Ku birebana n'ibibazo biri mu bubasha
bwawo, Umuryango ushobora gushyiraho
uburyo bukwiye bwo kujya inama n`ubwo
kugirana ubufatanye n`imiryango
mpuzamahanga itari iya Leta ndetse, iyo
byemewe n`igihugu bireba, n`imiryango yo
ku rwego rw`igihugu, iya Leta cyangwa
itegamiye kuri Leta. Ayo Masezerano akorwa
n'Umuyobozi Mukuru nyuma yo kwemezwa
na Komite Mpuzabikorwa.

articles.heading: Kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano (1) Ibihugu byavuzwe mu ngingo ya 5 bishobora kuba ibihuriye kuri aya
articles.text:
Masezerano no kuba mu bigize Umuryango
mu buryo bukurikira:
(i) biyashyizeho umukono hadategerejwe ko
yemezwa burundu, cyangwa
(ii) biyashyiraho umukono haseguriwe ko
yemezwa burundu bikurikiwe no gutanga
inyandiko ijyanye no kuyemeza burundu,
cyangwa
(iii) gutanga inyandiko yo kwemera kuba
kimwe mu bihugu biyahuriyeho.
(2) Hatitawe ku zindi ngingo z'aya
Masezerano, igihugu kiri mu Masezerano ya
Paris, Amasezerano ya Berne, cyangwa
yombi, gishobora gusa kuba muri aya
Masezerano kibera icyarimwe cyangwa
cyarabaye mbere, cyemeza burundu cyangwa
cyemera kuba kimwe haba mu Itegeko rya
Stockholm ry’Amasezerano ya Paris yose
cyangwa hakurikijwe ikumira gusa
riteganyijwe mu ngingo ya 20 (1) (b) (i) yayo,
cyangwa itegeko rya Stockholm
ry’amasezerano ya Berne yose uko yakabaye
cyangwa hakurikijwe ikumira riteganyijwe
mu ngingo ya 28 (1) (b) ) (i) yaryo.
(3) Inyandiko zo kuyemeza burundu cyangwa
kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu
biyahuriyeho zibikwa n'Umuyobozi Mukuru.

articles.heading: Igihe Amasezerano atangirira gukurikizwa (1) Aya Masezerano atangira gukurikizwa mu mezi atatu nyuma y'uko ibihugu icumi bigize
articles.text:
Ihuriro rya Paris n'ibihugu birindwi bigize
Ihuriro rya Berne byamaze gukora kimwe mu
bikorwa nk'uko biteganywa n'ingingo ya
14(1), byumvikane neza ko iyo igihugu kiri
muri ayo Mahuriro yombi kibarwa hombi.
Kuri iyo tariki, aya Masezerano atangira
kandi gukurikizwa mu bihugu bitabarizwa
muri rimwe mu Mahuriro abiri yavuzwe
haruguru, ariko byakozwe kimwe mu
bikorwa nk’uko biteganywa n'ingingo ya
14(1), amezi atatu cyangwa hejuru yayo
mbere y'iyo tariki.
(2) Ku birebana n'ibindi bihugu, aya
Masezerano atangira gukurikizwa amezi atatu
nyuma y'uko ibyo bihugu byafashe ingamba
zo gutangira kuyakurikiza nk'uko biteganywa
n'ingingo ya 14(1).

articles.heading: Ukwifata Nta kwifata kwemewe kuri aya Masezerano
Kuvugurura aya Masezerano (1) Ibyifuzo ku ivugururwa ry’aya Masezerano bishobora gutangwa n'igihugu
articles.text:
icyo ari cyo cyose kiri muri aya Masezerano,
na Komite Mpuzabikorwa cyangwa se
n'Umuyobozi Mukuru. Umuyobozi Mukuru
amenyesha ibyo byifuzo ibihugu byose bigize
Umuryango nibura amezi atandatu mbere
y'uko Inama ibyigaho.
(2) Amavugururwa yemezwa n'Inama. Igihe
cyose amavugururwa ashobora kugira
ingaruka ku burenganzira n'inshingano
by'ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
nubwo byaba bitari mu Ihuriro na rimwe, ibyo
bihugu nabyo bigomba gutora. Ku yandi
mavugururwa yose yifujwe gukorwa kuri aya
Masezerano, ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano kandi bibarizwa muri rimwe mu
Mahuriro ni byo byonyine byemererwa
gutora. Amavugururwa yemezwa
n'ubwiganze busanzwe bw'amajwi yabazwe,
igihe cyose Inama itora gusa ibyifuzo
byatanzwe ku ivugururwa ry’aya Masezerano
nk'uko biba byarabanje kwemezwa n'Inteko
Rusange y'Ihuriro rya Paris n'Inteko Rusange
y'Ihuriro rya Berne hashingiwe ku mategeko
agenga buri Huriro arebana no kwemeza
amavugururwa ku ngingo zijyanye
n'imicungire y'Amasezerano y'ayo Mahuriro
yombi.
(3) Amavugururwa yose kuri aya Masezerano
atangira gukurikizwa ukwezi kumwe nyuma
y'uko amamenyesha yo kwemera iryo
vugururwa, yakozwe hashingiwe ku buryo
busanzwe bukurikizwa kandi bwemewe
n'Itegeko nshinga muri buri gihugu, yakiriwe
n'Umuyobozi Mukuru yatanzwe na bitatu bya
kane by'ibihugu bigize Umuryango
byemerewe gutora ibyifuzo byatanzwe ku
ivugururwa ry’aya Masezerano hashingiwe
ku biteganywa mu gika cya (2), igihe Inama
yemeje ayo mavugururwa. Amavugururwa
yose yemewe akurikizwa ku bihugu byose
bigize Umuryango guhera igihe atangiriyeho
gukurikizwa no ku bihugu bizawinjiramo
nyuma. Icyakora, amavugururwa yatuma
inshingano ku birebana n'imari ziyongera ku
bihugu bigize Umuryango akurikizwa gusa
ku bihugu byayemeye.

articles.heading: Kwivana muri aya Masezerano Igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose gishobora kwivana muri aya Masezerano kibimenyesheje
articles.text:
Umuyobozi Mukuru.
(2) Kwivana muri aya Masezerano
bikurikizwa mu mezi atandatu nyuma y'uko
Umuyobozi Mukuru yakiriye inyandiko
ibimumenyesha.

articles.heading: Amamenyesha Umuyobozi Mukuru amenyesha Guverinoma z'ibihugu bigize Umuryango ibi bikurikira
articles.text:
(i) itariki aya Masezerano atangiriraho
gukurikizwa,
(ii) ishyirwa ry’umukono kuri aya
Masezerano no gutanga inyandiko yo
kuyemeza burundu cyangwa kwemera kuba
kimwe mu biyahuriyeho,
(iii) kwemera ivugururwa ry'aya Masezerano
ndetse n'itariki ingingo zavuguruwe
zitangiriraho gukurikizwa,
(iv) Kwivana muri aya Masezerano.

articles.heading: Ingingo zisoza (1) (a) Aya Masezerano ashyirwaho umukono ku nyandukuro imwe rukumbi iri mu ndimi
articles.text:
z'Icyongereza, Igifaransa, Ikirusiya
n'Icyesipanyolo. Inyandiko muri izo ndimi
zose zinganya agaciro kandi zibikwa na
Guverinoma ya Suwedi.
(b) Aya Masezerano yemerewe gukomeza
gushyirwaho umukono i Stockholm kugeza
ku wa 13 Mutarama 1968.
(2) Inyandiko z'umwimerere zizatunganywa
n'Umuyobozi Mukuru, amaze kubijyaho
inama na Guverinoma zibyifuza, mu rurimi
rw'Ikidage, Igitaliyani n'Igiporutugali, ndetse
n'izindi ndimi nk'uko bishobora kwemezwa
n'Inama.
(3) Umuyobozi Mukuru ashyikiriza
inyandikuro ebyiri z'umwimerere z`aya
Masezerano n'iz'ingingo zose zavuguruwe
zemejwe n'Inama Guverinoma z'ibihugu
bigize Ihuriro rya Paris n'irya Berne,
Guverinoma z'ibindi bihugu byose bihuriye
kuri aya Masezerano, na Guverinoma z'ibindi
bihugu byose igihe bibisabye. Inyandukuro
zihuje n’umwimerere z'aya Masezerano
zohererezwa Guverinoma zigomba kubanza
kwemezwa na Guverinoma ya Suwedi.
(4) Umuyobozi Mukuru yandikisha aya
Masezerano mu bunyamabanga
bw'Umuryango w'Abibumbye.

articles.heading: Ingingo z'inzibacyuho (1) Kugeza igihe Umuyobozi Mukuru wa mbere atangiriye imirimo, ibiteganywa muri
articles.text:
aya Masezerano bireba Ibiro Mpuzamahanga
cyangwa Umuyobozi Mukuru bizarebwa
n'Ibiro Mpuzamahanga bishinzwe kurengera
Umutungo w’Inganda, Ubuvanganzo
n’Ubugeni ( ndetse n`Ibiro Mpuzamahanga
by’Umuryango w’Abibumbye bishinzwe
kurengera Umutungo Bwite mu by'Ubwenge
(BIRPI)), cyangwa Umuyobozi wabyo.
(2) (a) Ibihugu biri muri rimwe mu Mahuriro
yavuzwe haruguru ariko bitarebwa n'aya
Masezerano, bishobora gukoresha
uburenganzira bumwe n'ubw'ibindi bihugu
